viz_p12.title: JVM Heap Memory Usage vs Max

options.query:
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="kraftcontroller"  BY pod span=1m
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval pod_series=series."-".pod
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by pod_series

| mstats sum(_value) as used WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="kraftcontroller"  BY pod span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by pod
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)
| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="kraftcontroller"

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by pod
| eval value=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="kraftcontroller"  BY pod span=1m
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval pod_series=series."-".pod
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by pod_series

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by pod
| eval used=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="kraftcontroller"  BY pod span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by pod
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| stats latest(rate) as value

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="kraftcontroller"

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval instance_series=series."-".'service.instance.id'
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by instance_series

| mstats avg(_value) as used WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by service.instance.id
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by service.instance.id
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| timechart span=1m avg(rate) by service.instance.id

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_threads_current" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_current_leader" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_current_vote" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_current_epoch" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_value" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" name="MetadataErrorCount" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_number_unknown_voter_connections" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_poll_idle_ratio_avg" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_high_watermark" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$" BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="high_watermark-".'service.instance.id'
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_log_end_offset" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$" BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="log_end_offset-".'service.instance.id'
]
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by series

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_commit_latency_avg" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$" BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="avg-".'service.instance.id'
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_commit_latency_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$" BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="max-".'service.instance.id'
]
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by series

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_election_latency_avg" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$" BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="avg-".'service.instance.id'
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_election_latency_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$" BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="max-".'service.instance.id'
]
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by series

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_append_records_rate" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$" BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="append-".'service.instance.id'
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_server_raft_metrics_fetch_records_rate" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="kafka-controller" service.instance.id="$pod$" BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="fetch-".'service.instance.id'
]
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by series

title: Confluent KRaft Controller Resources (Memory, CPU, JVM)
description: Per-pod container resource usage, JVM heap/GC/thread metrics, and KRaft quorum health (current leader/vote/epoch, unknown voter connections, poll idle ratio, high watermark/log end offset, commit/election latency, append/fetch rate) for KRaft controller pods in the confluent namespace.
